title: Ohm Boy Wild Strawberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Ohm Boy have worked their magic again with the dreamy, nostalgic flavour of authentic, ripe wild strawberries, ripened to sweet perfection in the English summer sunshine. Perfectly balanced with rich, deep, subtle sour notes of true, natural strawberry. A great authentic pineapple Dominate tropical fruit flavour, balanced with the sweetness of a ripe mango and delicately finished off with a lip smacking sharp lime. This flavour brings accuracy and a great rounded tropical taste! This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered mods and sub-ohm tanks .
